description: This file defines the ArchiveManager class responsible for handling backup and export functionalities, including zipping files, downloading backups, and managing file naming conventions within a larger application.

classes.name: ArchiveManager
classes.description: Main class managing archive-related operations such as backup creation, zipping, and file downloads.

methods.name: sanitizeFileName
methods.description: Sanitizes a filename by replacing invalid characters with underscores.

methods.name: zippableFileName
methods.description: Generates a sanitized filename suitable for zipping, with optional suffix and format.

methods.name: formattedDateForExports
methods.description: Returns a formatted string of the current date for use in filenames.

methods.name: getZippedDecryptedItemsBlob
methods.description: Creates a zip Blob containing decrypted backup items and their contents.

methods.name: downloadZippedDecryptedItems
methods.description: Triggers download of the zipped decrypted backup data.

methods.name: zipData
methods.description: Creates a zip Blob from an array of files.

methods.name: downloadDataAsZip
methods.description: Downloads provided data as a zip file.

methods.name: hrefForData
methods.description: Creates an object URL for a Blob for download purposes.

methods.name: downloadData
methods.description: Creates a download link for a Blob or URL and triggers the download.

methods.name: downloadEncryptedItem
methods.description: Downloads a single encrypted item as a text file.

methods.name: downloadEncryptedItems
methods.description: Downloads multiple encrypted items as a JSON file.
